Police verification requirement for e-Passport is CONDITIONAL: Dubai mission (Tier 2) states PV is mandatory for first-time Bangladeshi passport/e-Passport applications and may not be required when no PV is needed and there is no NID/BRC data mismatch on reissue.
claims.evidence_excerpt: For first-time ... police verification is mandatory ... If no police verification is required ... expected within 15 days (domestic) / 4-6 weeks (mission).
claims.evidence_limitation: No Tier-1 DIP circular explicitly stating universal vs conditional rule captured; classification based on Tier-2 mission guidance plus onboarding police-station routing.
